meta.name: aerodrome-rewards
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user asks about "rewards", "bribes", "fees", "VotingReward", "BribeVotingReward", "FeesVotingReward", "ManagedReward", or needs to understand Aerodrome's reward distribution system.

copy.tagline: 看懂 Aerodrome 的奖励与贿赂分配逻辑
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想搞清楚 Aerodrome 里各种奖励从哪来、怎么分配。
copy.tagline_en: Understand Aerodrome's reward distribution and bribe flows.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to understand how Aerodrome rewards and bribes are distributed.

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 能讲解 Aerodrome 的奖励发放机制:交易费归 FeesVotingReward、外部贿赂归 BribeVotingReward 发给投票者;托管 NFT 的复利奖励进 LockedManagedReward、可领取奖励进 FreeManagedReward。
howto.when: 当用户提到 rewards、bribes、fees 等关键词,或询问 VotingReward、ManagedReward 等 Aerodrome 奖励分配相关内容时触发。

say.text: Aerodrome 的 FeesVotingReward 怎么给投票者发交易费?
say.note: Claude 会结合合约代码解释发放流程。

say.text: 在 BribeVotingReward 里,项目方怎么添加贿赂?

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can explain Aerodrome's reward distribution: FeesVotingReward gives trading fees to voters, BribeVotingReward gives bribes to voters; LockedManagedReward compounds rewards in managed NFTs, FreeManagedReward lets depositors claim.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions keywords like rewards, bribes, fees, or asks about VotingReward, ManagedReward, or Aerodrome's reward distribution.

say_en.text: How does FeesVotingReward distribute trading fees to voters?
say_en.note: Claude explains the flow using contract code.

say_en.text: How does a project add bribes to BribeVotingReward?
What's the difference between LockedManagedReward and FreeManagedReward?
say_en.note: Claude compares the two managed reward rules.
